provenance.method: Review each bounded proposal against morphology, surface coverage, source-bound paragraph identifiers, and local contexts. Admit verified in-scope identities after separate POS and single-sense review; hold only evidenced identity, POS, sense, or surface-collision uncertainty. Analyzer counts, writer usefulness, and relation counts do not determine lexical eligibility.

source.name: NIKL Written Corpus 2025 local reference snapshot

index.sample_policy: one paragraph when paragraph ordinal modulo 20 is zero, within each source-ordered document

typewriter_surface.normalization: Unicode NFC plus surrounding whitespace trim, matching runtime search input

selection.selection_rationale: The deterministic source-count order sets a bounded candidate review queue only; each disposition follows separate identity, POS, sense, and coverage review.

extraction_error_classes: one-best morphology can misclassify unknown or context-ambiguous forms
compound segmentation can surface morphemes that still need lexical-boundary review
POS and lemma confidence have no calibrated score in this pilot
